name: Barack Obama
subject: Our challenge is to answer the call to defend democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
It’s our turn to strengthen the fabric of our nation.

---
Peter, America will celebrate its 250th birthday next week. It can be easy to overlook just how incredible — and improbable — this milestone is. America has always been an experiment, defined by the belief that people united not by race or ethnicity but by a shared set of ideals can live and work together. We’ve seen the power of that belief over the last two and a half centuries. But our democracy has never been self-executing. At every turn, we’ve had to keep it alive. Revolutionaries, inventors, abolitionists, suffragists, civil rights leaders, entrepreneurs, and organizers have worked and sacrificed to keep us moving forward. Of course, there have always been people who don’t believe in the American experiment — leaders who put their self-interest ahead of the common good, and would prefer to take us backward rather than give up their own wealth and power. But generation after generation, the American people have prevailed. They’ve rolled up their sleeves, locked arms, and done the hard work of building a more perfect union. **Now it’s our turn to answer the call. ** **The National Democratic Redistricting Committee has a plan to defeat the gerrymandering that threatens fair elections so we can ensure that the will of the people ultimately prevails. clean_body: It’s our turn to strengthen the fabric of our nation. Peter, America will celebrate its 250th birthday next week. It can be easy to overlook just how incredible — and improbable — this milestone is. America has always been an experiment, defined by the belief that people united not by race or ethnicity but by a shared set of ideals can live and work together. We’ve seen the power of that belief over the last two and a half centuries. But our democracy has never been self-executing. At every turn, we’ve had to keep it alive. Revolutionaries, inventors, abolitionists, suffragists, civil rights leaders, entrepreneurs, and organizers have worked and sacrificed to keep us moving forward. Of course, there have always been people who don’t believe in the American experiment — leaders who put their self-interest ahead of the common good, and would prefer to take us backward rather than give up their own wealth and power. But generation after generation, the American people have prevailed. They’ve rolled up their sleeves, locked arms, and done the hard work of building a more perfect union. Well, what I'm about to tell you will make - or break - our chances of defending the President's Senate Majority in the midterms. If these trends hold, our conservative candidates could be in real danger! And the same reason we're falling behind in these key states is the same problem we've been seeing for the last year: Too many Republican voters are sitting on the sidelines! Some politicians have resorted to criticizing GOP voters, even going as far as to accuse them of being "Democrats" because they don't feel motivated to cast a ballot. I'm not going to do that. A vote has to be . We're not entitled to it! If we want America First conservatives like you to show up and vote for us in November, then we need to make sure that we're fighting for YOUR top priorities. You know better than anyone what we need to do to re-energize the base, turn out our voters, and defy history by winning the midterm elections! ---
Peter,
The New York Times ran a piece asking a question that would have sounded impossible two years ago: **is this the year Florida turns blue?**
They watched us flip the Miami mayor's office, a long-shot State Senate seat, and even the State House district that covers Mar-a-Lago. And they came away taking David's campaign seriously, because they see what we see: **Florida is ready for a new direction.**
**[When the national press starts paying attention, so do our opponents. So we have to ask: will you chip in $10 between our campaign and Blue Amp Action right now to keep this momentum going?](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/13934?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.01_Jolly-Polling_B4_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2597%2E259176%2EEPCuti)**
Here's what David has been saying on the road. _We’re winning._
We know how that sounds in a state that hasn't elected a Democratic Governor in a generation. But David has been in every corner of Florida, and what he's hearing is that people are exhausted. They're tired of the culture wars, the toxicity, and leaders who pick fights instead of solving problems.
What they want is someone laser-focused on the cost of housing, health care, and electricity. They want someone who focus on the things that unite us, and on tackling the issues we all face together.
Here's the catch, and the Times printed this too. Our opponent Byron Donalds has raised a massive warchest, and it’s only July.
The GOP is ready to pour hundreds of millions of dollars into this race, bankrolled by the special interests that have run Tallahassee for thirty years. They'll spend whatever it takes to ensure they hold on to power.
We are not going to match them dollar for dollar. We don't have to.
**What we have to do is the work, neighbor to neighbor, conversation by conversation, all across this state. That's how we built this moment, and that's how we protect it.**

# Thursday, July 2, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1776, [the Second Continental Congress](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwQ6DF0e0oPgbu_nbLQ3CZWSCMIE7Gt9-M5t9g62_5Jyc83Vf7ibEkB7_zY6afF4SnjUiEZbl-Y5Xv6Gh0xz4rjVbi4XQ7AsIGLhQXMDiTIjX0jdOe0RA2aDu1AjTqMR0azatzHhzflgH6dXqvBceJunXdRycg6nzTdCfNKEEdKLrJLQgjbVeGqtWYVEA6wW6QLm0zxwSbejjlQ8src17E_VG9KpM_mMwM5jP82y3UCmX6-MMZtpC5c5cPCT-KwzmzzYODGab06NgrfzIhJX7XHhIDl-YHCaLTdHudYYYQx0U68VjNyH-NNOf7jo0fAcAAP__aqOB0A) approved Richard Henry Lee's resolution declaring the American colonies independent from Great Britain.
